title: HTTP servers
explain: The standard library can run a web server with no framework. `http.HandleFunc` connects a path to a function that writes the response, and `ListenAndServe` starts listening on a port. Go 1.22 also lets patterns include a method and wildcards, like `GET /users/{id}`.
exercise: Add a `/health` route that returns `ok`, then test it with `curl localhost:8080/health`.
tip: `ListenAndServe` returns an error, for example when the port is already in use. Wrap it in `log.Fatal` so you can see why the server stopped.
